metadata.title: Universal 2-Adic Torsion Laws in Nisan Matrices for Higher-Degree Witt Carries

e2_sym_M1.first_witt_depth_law: At n = 2^r + 1, top factor 2^r vanishes in W_j(F_2) for j <= r and emerges at W_{r+1}(F_2) = Z/2^{r+1}Z

e3_sym_M12.first_witt_depth_law: At n = 2^r + 2, top factor 2^r vanishes in W_j(F_2) for j <= r and emerges at W_{r+1}(F_2) = Z/2^{r+1}Z

e4_sym_M22_kneser.v2_spectrum_law_even_n: (0^{binom(n,2)-1}, v_2(n-2) - 1); single torsion factor emerging at W_{v_2(n-2)}(F_2)
e4_sym_M22_kneser.v2_spectrum_law_odd_n: Let r = v_2(n-3) >= 1: (0^{n(n-3)/2}, (r-1)^1, r^{n-1}); linear-size block of (n-1) simultaneous 2^r-torsion factors emerging at W_{r+1}(F_2) for n = 2^r + 3

c2_witt_second_carry_Z16.ordered_vs_symmetrized_Z16_rank: 4*C_2^{ord} has Z/16Z rank n - 3, whereas 4*C_2^{sym} reaches binom(n, 2) (e.g. 28 vs 5 at n=8); at n=7, 6 factors of 4-torsion in C_2^sym vanish mod 16 under 4x scaling and require W_5(F_2)=Z/32Z
